_status: DESIGN ONLY, not yet staffed. Reference-prototype, UNAUDITED. Attests nothing.
_honesty: Badge rules for NoporIS. A badge is a claim; on stock Android an attestation claim is never true, so it is never rendered. The Google-Play persona is badged 'less private', never a padlock it has not earned. Any renderer MUST fail closed: if a claim is not proven true here, do not draw the badge.
invariants: Attestation is shown ONLY where it is genuinely true. On stock Android it is never true, so no persona ever receives a padlock / 'attested' / 'verified' / 'secure' / 'sealed' badge.
The Google-Play persona is badged 'less private', never a padlock it hasn't earned.
Fail closed: an unknown or absent proof renders NO positive badge, only the honest negative one.
No badge implies NoporIS is an OS, a Seal, Porog, or hardware-backed isolation. It is an unprivileged app on stock Android.
Play Integrity STRONG fails on both personas by design; no badge may imply it passes.

forbiddenBadges.note: These must NEVER be rendered for any persona on any NoporIS surface, because they would be false on stock Android.

clean.explain: The clean persona is sandboxed by Android's work-profile mechanism (Android's isolation, not Postern's). Sandboxed is not secure, private, or attested. The badge states the system-type trade-off only; it never claims attestation.

google.label: less private
google.explain: The Google-Play persona runs Google Play Services and phones home to Google. It is the less-private, non-attestable side by construction. It is ALWAYS badged 'less private' and NEVER a padlock. NoporIS sells separation + convenience here, not privacy.

attestationRule.reason: There is no measured-boot roothash of a persona. Play Integrity / key attestation measure the whole device (bootloader lock, verified boot, TEE), not a persona — they attest the phone, not the workspace. A rooted / unlocked / compromised host defeats the separation. Therefore no attestation badge is ever true here and none is drawn.

bridgeBadges.rule: Cross-persona bridges (clipboard, contacts, files) render OFF unless the consent-gate state is the literal 'enabled'. NoporIS cannot open a bridge itself; the badge reflects state it only reads. Anything but 'enabled' renders OFF.
